'''Worr Muugyn''' was a young [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who fought during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. During a skirmish between Mandalorian and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces on [[Vur IV]], Muugyn refused orders to abandon the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] when the Jedi regrouped in a neutral sector and rallied volunteers to fortify a position known as [[Blood Ridge]]. Muugyn and his followers proceeded to mount a counterattack against the Jedi and survived the [[Battle of Blood Ridge]]. He went on to lead Mandalorian forces until he died in battle in [[3959 BBY]].<ref name="Codex" />
